plan.checkpoint_identity_note: Path and file metadata are recorded; no new full weights hash is claimed.
plan.noise_identity: Per-request seed in infer.jsonl and inputs NPZ; GPU FP32 torch.randn((1,10,action_dim)) using a fresh CUDA Generator.manual_seed(seed). No noise tensor bytes/hash are exposed by this server.
plan.schedule: Eight fixed suite/task/init identities; rotate whole-episode condition order by case; one persistent model and one environment client
plan.semantics: lead0/1/3/6 are approximate per-Euler mixed old/new layer KV algorithms; fresh18 uses fully current KV. Every episode starts with one current-frame full Prefill and fresh original AE. No future observation or next encoder is invented. Free closed-loop trajectories may diverge; exact equality versus fresh is not required.
plan.video_policy: No full videos: worker-scoped imageio writer discards frames, retaining original capture/telemetry and action execution calls. Result video field is explicitly null.
plan.measurements: Original run_episode seeds, env init, settling, H10/R5, actions, inputs/hashes and EEF telemetry; additionally retain normalized actions, per-step KV frontiers, Pool/generation metadata and request latency. Rendering/client/I/O costs remain in closed-loop wall time.
limitations: Eight fixed cases per selected mode are an exploratory quality test, not official full LIBERO evaluation.
This run validates mixed-KV quality without next-encoder lookahead; it cannot establish the throughput of a system with available next observations.
CUDA-visible client devices are empty; EGL intentionally uses the explicitly assigned GPU and is checked by inherited C/G namespace-aware guards.
First-request capture and fresh bootstrap are cold costs, excluded from steady latency summaries.
Executed sources must remain frozen from plan creation to server shutdown.
plan.bootstrap: Lazy first predict: retain captured graphs across resets/tasks, bootstrap current Prefix once and use original AE on it; bootstrap/capture latency reported separately

notes: Each resource configuration uses the original eight suite/task/init cases and passed original seed/D10/H10/R5/EGL validation receipts.
Actual SM allocations and encoder_after_step=1 are verified from every resource-run inference protocol. next_encoder=False everywhere.
Bootstrap compares normal GPU0 fresh18 input, seed, normalized actions and decoded actions; cross-GPU differences are reported directly without assuming exact equality.

approximation_delta is separate from strict conditioning comparisons: only request1 is compared, after matching current input, bootstrap/old input, both seeds, source IDs and model D/H/R/config/checkpoint; frontiers may differ intentionally.
H10 delta is over all decoded [10,7] values; R5 delta is over the first five scheduled actions. Actual executed length is recorded separately in case an episode ends early.
No later diverged request is compared. No gripper-flip metric or invented threshold is used.
Steady RPC distributions pool free closed-loop trajectories and run on different GPUs; they are not controlled same-input hardware speedups.
Task failures remain valid quality outcomes; technical failures are separate. Existing strict conditioning files and all frozen sources are untouched.
